n: 400 Series Electric Front Load Dryer - 8.0 Cu. Ft.
desc: The Front Load Electric Dryer from Electrolux headquarters has a dryer capacity of 8 cu.ft. This dryer from Electrolux products range is capable of 18-minutes Fast Dry cycle to urgently clean clothes. The Instant Refresh Cycle feature of this dryer instantly cleans clothes without wrinkles.
hl: Keeps clothes looking their best without over drying
Clothes are gently tumbled while moisture sensors detect when clothes are dry to prevent over-drying.
Quickly dry the items you need most.

Gently tumbles your clothes without heat to keep them tangle-free--perfect for when you cannot remove clothes right after the cycle ends.
Dry more in each load with our 8.0 Cu. Ft. dryers.
